source.document: Image Creation and Editing Skill Catalog

modes.local: fully implemented locally; produces real files with no external service
modes.assisted: local deterministic output (composition, palette, prompt, spec) plus an optional provider for photoreal synthesis
modes.review: produces analysis, measurements or plans that a human must act on; the judgement itself is not automated
modes.provider: requires a configured external provider; the local tool supplies inputs and provenance only
